Thanks for the heads-up, Alex — and sorry for the friction. That screenshot helps. This looks like an HTML-escaping problem inside the ICS description/href (we've seen some exporters remove the href attribute when the <a> tag contains certain characters).

Quick options so we don't lose the slot:
- I can paste a direct Zoom join link in this thread; you and the engineers can join that immediately.
- Ben (cc'd) can reissue the calendar invite with me as the organizer and attach a fresh .ics that we've validated against Outlook/GCal.

Do you prefer we keep the 9:30 slot and just drop the Zoom link, or should we resend a new invite so the calendar client shows the proper Join button? If you want the resend, I'll set myself as organizer to avoid the exporter mismatch.

If you can confirm Okta/SSO requirements for your team (do they need SSO-protected meetings?), flag that too — I'll include the host SSO note in the invite.

Thanks,
